title: Needle retrieval at 256K, 512K and 1M tokens, both engines, K3.25 (one request per prompt and engine)
question: Do tpurtell's vLLM fork v0.9.2 and CuteAFD v3.0.1, serving K3.25, accept prompts of 256K, 512K and 1M tokens and return planted needles from them?
engines: tpurtell vLLM fork v0.9.2 (image digest not stated in this run)
tpurtell CuteAFD v3.0.1 (image digest not stated in this run)
hardware: not stated in this run's files

goals.question: At 262,144, 524,288 and 1,000,000 content tokens, does each engine finish on its own and return the single secret code, and all six KEY=VALUE records in document order?
goals.added_source: README.md:1 (EXPLORATORY, feasibility pilot, not part of a frozen protocol); RUN.json slots.pilot

design.instrument: one chat request per prompt and engine, thinking on, temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, max_tokens 16,384, one request at a time on an idle server; found = code in the reply after the reasoning, 6/6 in order = all six records in document order
design.items: 6 prompts following tpurtell's two needle designs (scripts/test-long-context.py: one code near the start; scripts/test-multi-needle-vllm.py: six records at 5/25/50/75/95/99%), one of each at 256K, 512K and 1M tokens, each with its own nonce; prompt texts not published (sha256 in prompts-index.json)
design.repeats: none; one request per prompt and engine, the same seed per prompt on both engines

goals.headline: Exploratory, one request per cell: on K3.25 every one of the 12 requests finished with stop; the single code was found at 256K, 512K and 1M on both the vLLM fork v0.9.2 and CuteAFD v3.0.1, and the six-record prompts returned 6/6 in order on both. A feasibility result, not a quality result.

goals.question: How long does each engine take to the first token on these 256K, 512K and 1M-token prompts?
goals.added_source: README.md:1, README.md:15-22 (first-token columns of the pilot table)

design.instrument: time to first token per request, from the same 12 pilot requests
design.repeats: none; one request per prompt and engine

goals.headline: Exploratory, one request per cell, K3.25: first token at 262,156 prompt tokens 62.5-63.2 s on the vLLM fork v0.9.2 and 58.0-58.5 s on CuteAFD v3.0.1; at 524,300 tokens 129.8-132.2 s and 122.5-123.2 s; at 1,000,012 tokens 269.7-270.5 s and 254.2-255.4 s. Engines ran one after the other (13:03 and 13:20); no replicates.
